articles.title: 330 Drug Samples Fail Quality Tests Across India, 93 From Himachal
articles.summary: Of the failed samples manufactured in Himachal Pradesh, products from 73 pharmaceutical companies in Solan district, 18 in Sirmaur and two in Una were found to be non-compliant with the required standards. articles.title: Indian Fugitive Gangster Himanshu Bhau Arrested in the United States

articles.summary: Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi will return for India in the second Twenty20 International against New Zealand in Christchurch on Saturday. Following an injury to Ishan Kishan, the youngster is expected to open the batting. India leads the series after a high-scoring opener, while New Zealand aims to bounce back using their powerful batting lineup and spin options.

articles.title: Good news for passengers: Chhattisgarh to get new railway projects; 100 additional trains
articles.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said the projects could create capacity for at least 100 additional trains to operate in the state. The expansion includes third and fourth railway lines on key routes, alongside new passenger services between Raipur and Raoghat and between Raipur and Kurud. The projects are aimed at increasing rail capacity and improving access to the state capital.

articles.title: Delayed transfers cleared: Gujarat relieves primary teachers waiting since 2022
articles.summary: Gujarat education department has ordered the complete relieving of primary school teachers who have been awaiting district or taluka transfers since 2022-23 despite receiving transfer orders. The decision provides relief to teachers whose transfers were stalled due to the rule requiring schools to maintain at least 50% of their sanctioned staff strength.

articles.title: Delhi Police Transfers Fifty Seven FIRs To Crime Branch
articles.summary: The Delhi Police has transferred all fifty seven first information reports linked to the Jantar Mantar protest to the Crime Branch. This decision was made due to workload and sensitivity reasons to ensure a unified probe. The investigation will now be handled entirely by the specialized unit to streamline the ongoing legal proceedings moving forward.

articles.title: Central Forensic Science Laboratory Report Links Four Accused to Bawana Rape and Murder
articles.summary: A Central Forensic Science Laboratory DNA report has linked all four accused men to the rape and murder of a minor in outer Delhi. Police stated that Y-STR test results match the victim samples, supporting the ongoing sexual assault investigation. This evidence strengthens the case as authorities move forward with legal proceedings against the suspects involved.

articles.title: Who is Amir Shokeen? Delhi-based influencer under fire for ‘Chinese jibe’ at Tripura youth
articles.summary: Amir Shokeen, the Delhi-based content creator apprehended for hurling racial abuse at a Tripura youth, was remanded to one-day judicial custody in a case registered at Sadar Bazar Police Station. DCP North District Niharika Bhatt said on Thursday that police registered a case after coming across the incident on social media.

articles.title: Indian Union Muslim League Promises Action Over Doha Office Heist
articles.summary: The Indian Union Muslim League has promised strict action following fresh allegations linking organization members to a major theft. Over three million Qatari riyals were stolen from the Doha office of the Kerala Muslim Cultural Centre. The incident has deepened an ongoing mystery as investigators examine potential internal involvement in the high-profile financial crime.

articles.title: Swadeshi Jagaran Manch urges Narendra Modi to block Starlink in India
articles.summary: The Swadeshi Jagaran Manch urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to deny operating permissions for SpaceX satellite internet service Starlink in New Delhi on October 23, 2026. Citing national security concerns, the affiliate of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh advocated for developing a homegrown satellite network instead. The Union government has not yet approved spectrum allotment requests for three companies.

articles.title: Pratika Rawal and Shree Charani lead India to victory over Zimbabwe

articles.summary: Google and NODWIN Gaming have announced Google Play Arena, a new mobile gaming championship featuring popular titles such as BGMI, Free Fire MAX, Mobile Legends, Real Cricket, Chess. com and EA SPORTS FC Mobile. Former Indian cricket captain MS Dhoni will participate through his esports club, Mahi Clutchers, which will recruit players through open qualifiers.
articles.title_hi: Google Play Arena पंजीकरण खुले: खेल, तिथियां और एमएस धोनी के माही क्लचर्स
articles.summary_hi: Google और NODWIN गेमिंग ने Google Play Arena की घोषणा की है, जो एक नई मोबाइल गेमिंग चैंपियनशिप है जिसमें BGMI, Free Fire MAX, मोबाइल लीजेंड्स, रियल क्रिकेट, शतरंज जैसे लोकप्रिय शीर्षक शामिल हैं। कॉम और ईए स्पोर्ट्स एफसी मोबाइल। पूर्व भारतीय क्रिकेट कप्तान एमएस धोनी अपने ईस्पोर्ट्स क्लब, माही क्लचर्स के माध्यम से भाग लेंगे, जो ओपन क्वालीफायर के माध्यम से खिलाड़ियों की भर्ती करेगा।
articles.title_hinglish: Google Play Arena panjikarana khule: khel, tithiyan aura emaesa dhoni ke mahi klacharsa
articles.summary_hinglish: Google aura NODWIN geminga ne Google Play Arena ki ghoshana ki hai, jo eka naee mobaila geminga chainpiyanashipa hai jisamen BGMI, Free Fire MAX, mobaila lijends, riyala kriket, shataranja jaise lokapriya shirshaka shamila hain। koma aura eee sportsa ephasi mobaila। purva bharatiya kriketa kaptana emaesa dhoni apane eesportsa klab, mahi klacharsa ke madhyama se bhaga lenge, jo opana kvaliphayara ke madhyama se khiladaिyon ki bharti karega।

articles.title: RSS-affiliate SJM urges Centre to deny Starlink licence on security grounds
articles.summary: In a memorandum submitted to Prime Minister Narendra Modi following a demonstration against Starlink at the Teen Murti Chowk in New Delhi, the RSS-affiliated organisation said the company's use of laser-based satellite links to transmit data directly between satellites raises concerns about Indian internet traffic bypassing domestic gateways during security-related emergencies.

articles.title_hi: फोर्ब्स इंडिया विभिन्न उद्योगों में विकास को बढ़ावा देने वाले विश्वसनीय ब्रांडों पर प्रकाश डालता है

articles.title_hinglish: phorbsa indiya vibhinna udyogon men vikasa ko badhaाva dene vale vishvasaniya brandon para prakasha dalata hai
articles.summary_hinglish: phorbsa indiya ne vibhinna kshetron men utkrishtata aura navachara ke madhyama se rashtriya aarthika vikasa ko badhaाva dene vali ullekhaniya kanpaniyon ko ujagara kiya hai। vishesha phichara krishna dayagnostiksa aura vudenastrita jaise vyavasayon ko pradarshita karata hai jo grahakon ke anubhavon ko badalane aura sthayi avasaron ka nirmana karane ke lie vishvas, gunavatta aura duradarshi rananitiyon ko jodate hain। ye sthapita aura ubharate sangathana dirghakalika prabhava ke prati apani pratibaddhata ke madhyama se udyogon ko majabuta karana jari rakhate hain।

articles.summary_hi: यदि आप बाहर निकलना चाहते हैं, तो कृपया इस पृष्ठ के पाद लेख में "मेरी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी न बेचें या साझा न करें" लिंक पर क्लिक करें। हम आपके द्वारा देखे जाने वाले विज्ञापनों को सूचित करने के लिए आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी को बेचेंगे या साझा नहीं करेंगे। यदि आपकी जानकारी अन्य कंपनियों द्वारा बेची या साझा की जाती है या पहले बेची या साझा की गई थी, तब भी आपको रुचि-आधारित विज्ञापन दिखाई दे सकते हैं।

articles.title: India rewrite Asian Para Games record, but not every sport keeps pace
articles.summary: India finished the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya with a record 114 medals, surpassing the country's previous best at the continental event. The final tally of 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals bettered India's 2023 performance in Hangzhou, when the contingent officially finished with 108 medals after three medals were later stripped following doping violations.
articles.title_hi: भारत ने एशियाई पैरा खेलों का रिकॉर्ड फिर से लिखा, लेकिन हर खेल गति बनाए नहीं रखता
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने आइची-नागोया में 2026 एशियाई पैरा खेलों को रिकॉर्ड 114 पदकों के साथ समाप्त किया, जो महाद्वीपीय आयोजन में देश के पिछले सर्वश्रेष्ठ से आगे निकल गया। 30 स्वर्ण, 35 रजत और 49 कांस्य पदकों की अंतिम तालिका ने हांग्जो में भारत के 2023 के प्रदर्शन को बेहतर बना दिया, जब डोपिंग उल्लंघन के बाद तीन पदक छीन लिए जाने के बाद दल आधिकारिक तौर पर 108 पदकों के साथ समाप्त हुआ।
articles.title_hinglish: bharata ne eshiyaee paira khelon ka rikorda phira se likh, lekina hara khela gati banae nahin rakhata
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata ne aaichi-nagoya men 2026 eshiyaee paira khelon ko rikorda 114 padakon ke satha samapta kiy, jo mahadvipiya aayojana men desha ke pichhale sarvashreshtha se aage nikala gaya। 30 svarn, 35 rajata aura 49 kansya padakon ki antima talika ne hangjo men bharata ke 2023 ke pradarshana ko behatara bana diy, jaba dopinga ullanghana ke bada tina padaka chhina lie jane ke bada dala aadhikarika taura para 108 padakon ke satha samapta huaa।

articles.title: 10th Military Literature Festival: 3-day event to be held in Chandigarh from Nov 13-15
articles.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann will preside over the closing ceremony. Group Captain Shubanshu Shukla, the first Indian astronaut to stay aboard the International Space Station, will deliver a talk titled “From Fighter Cockpit to Space Craft: India’s New Frontier in Air and Space Power”. A special session on space warfare has also been scheduled.
articles.title_hi: 10वां सैन्य साहित्य महोत्सव: 13-15 नवंबर तक चंडीगढ़ में 3 दिवसीय कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया जाएगा
articles.summary_hi: समापन समारोह की अध्यक्षता पंजाब के मुख्यमंत्री भगवंत मान करेंगे। ग्रुप कैप्टन शुभांशु शुक्ला, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अंतरिक्ष स्टेशन पर रहने वाले पहले भारतीय अंतरिक्ष यात्री, "फाइटर कॉकपिट से स्पेस क्राफ्ट तक: भारत की वायु और अंतरिक्ष शक्ति में नई सीमा" शीर्षक पर एक व्याख्यान देंगे। अंतरिक्ष युद्ध पर एक विशेष सत्र भी निर्धारित किया गया है।
articles.title_hinglish: 10van sainya sahitya mahotsav: 13-15 navanbara taka chandigadha men 3 divasiya karyakrama aayojita kiya jaega
articles.summary_hinglish: samapana samaroha ki adhyakshata panjaba ke mukhyamantri bhagavanta mana karenge। grupa kaiptana shubhanshu shukl, antarrashtriya antariksha steshana para rahane vale pahale bharatiya antariksha yatri, "phaitara kokapita se spesa kraphta tak: bharata ki vayu aura antariksha shakti men naee sima" shirshaka para eka vyakhyana denge। antariksha yuddha para eka vishesha satra bhi nirdharita kiya gaya hai।

articles.title: Major Indian companies announce series of chief financial officer leadership changes

articles.title_hi: प्रमुख भारतीय कंपनियों ने मुख्य वित्तीय अधिकारी के नेतृत्व में बदलाव की श्रृंखला की घोषणा की
articles.summary_hi: एबीबी इंडिया, फ्रैक्टल एनालिटिक्स और महिंद्रा मैनुलाइफ सहित कई प्रमुख भारतीय कंपनियों ने हाल ही में प्रमुख मुख्य वित्तीय अधिकारी नियुक्तियों की घोषणा की है। ये नेतृत्व परिवर्तन देश भर में विकसित हो रहे कॉर्पोरेट वित्त परिदृश्य को उजागर करते हैं। उद्योग विशेषज्ञ कॉर्पोरेट क्षेत्र के भीतर उभरती व्यावसायिक रणनीतियों और वित्तीय रुझानों के बारे में जानकारी हासिल करने के लिए इन कार्यकारी गतिविधियों की निगरानी करना जारी रखते हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: pramukha bharatiya kanpaniyon ne mukhya vittiya adhikari ke netritva men badalava ki shrrinkhala ki ghoshana ki
articles.summary_hinglish: ebibi indiy, phraiktala enalitiksa aura mahindra mainulaipha sahita kaee pramukha bharatiya kanpaniyon ne hala hi men pramukha mukhya vittiya adhikari niyuktiyon ki ghoshana ki hai। ye netritva parivartana desha bhara men vikasita ho rahe korporeta vitta paridrishya ko ujagara karate hain। udyoga visheshajnya korporeta kshetra ke bhitara ubharati vyavasayika rananitiyon aura vittiya rujhanon ke bare men janakari hasila karane ke lie ina karyakari gatividhiyon ki nigarani karana jari rakhate hain।

articles.title: Goa rationalises aviation turbine fuel VAT to 7% from October 24, IndiGo welcomes move
articles.summary: Goa government has announced a reduction in the value-added tax on aviation turbine fuel to 7%. This revised VAT rate will come into effect on October 24, 2026. IndiGo welcomed this decision, encouraging other states to implement similar measures. The airline believes this change will enhance air travel accessibility and boost the tourism sector in Goa.
articles.title_hi: गोवा ने 24 अक्टूबर से विमानन टरबाइन ईंधन वैट को तर्कसंगत बनाकर 7% कर दिया, इंडिगो ने इस कदम का स्वागत किया
articles.summary_hi: गोवा सरकार ने विमानन टरबाइन ईंधन पर मूल्यवर्धित कर को घटाकर 7% करने की घोषणा की है। यह संशोधित वैट दर 24 अक्टूबर, 2026 को लागू होगी। इंडिगो ने इस निर्णय का स्वागत किया, अन्य राज्यों को भी इसी तरह के उपाय लागू करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया। एयरलाइन का मानना ​​है कि इस बदलाव से हवाई यात्रा की पहुंच बढ़ेगी और गोवा में पर्यटन क्षेत्र को बढ़ावा मिलेगा।
articles.title_hinglish: gova ne 24 aktubara se vimanana tarabaina eendhana vaita ko tarkasangata banakara 7% kara diy, indigo ne isa kadama ka svagata kiya
articles.summary_hinglish: gova sarakara ne vimanana tarabaina eendhana para mulyavardhita kara ko ghatakara 7% karane ki ghoshana ki hai। yaha sanshodhita vaita dara 24 aktubar, 2026 ko lagu hogi। indigo ne isa nirnaya ka svagata kiy, anya rajyon ko bhi isi taraha ke upaya lagu karane ke lie protsahita kiya। eyaralaina ka manana ​​hai ki isa badalava se havaee yatra ki pahuncha badhaेgi aura gova men paryatana kshetra ko badhaाva milega।

articles.title: Mohanlal fans react to Vijay's 'I'm the Complete Actor' quip on KWK
articles.summary: Actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna’s appearance on Koffee With Karan has sparked an online debate after their reaction to learning that Malayalam superstar Mohanlal is popularly known as the ‘Complete Actor’. articles.title_hi: मोहनलाल के प्रशंसकों ने KWK पर विजय की 'मैं संपूर्ण अभिनेता हूं' वाली चुटकी पर प्रतिक्रिया व्यक्त की
articles.summary_hi: कॉफ़ी विद करण में अभिनेता विजय देवरकोंडा और रश्मिका मंदाना की उपस्थिति ने यह जानने के बाद कि मलयालम सुपरस्टार मोहनलाल को 'संपूर्ण अभिनेता' के रूप में जाना जाता है, उनकी प्रतिक्रिया के बाद एक ऑनलाइन बहस छेड़ दी है। शीर्षक पर युगल के स्पष्ट आश्चर्य ने मोहनलाल के प्रशंसकों का ध्यान आकर्षित किया है, कुछ लोगों ने अनुभवी अभिनेता से जुड़े उपनाम के साथ उनकी अपरिचितता पर सवाल उठाया है।
articles.title_hinglish: mohanalala ke prashansakon ne KWK para vijaya ki 'main sanpurna abhineta hun' vali chutaki para pratikriya vyakta ki
articles.summary_hinglish: kophaी vida karana men abhineta vijaya devarakonda aura rashmika mandana ki upasthiti ne yaha janane ke bada ki malayalama suparastara mohanalala ko 'sanpurna abhineta' ke rupa men jana jata hai, unaki pratikriya ke bada eka ऑnalaina bahasa chheda di hai। shirshaka para yugala ke spashta aashcharya ne mohanalala ke prashansakon ka dhyana aakarshita kiya hai, kuchha logon ne anubhavi abhineta se judaे upanama ke satha unaki aparichitata para savala uthaya hai।

articles.title: President Murmu delegates Dental commission act powers to UT administrators
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: President Droupadi Murmu has delegated powers to the Lieutenant Governors and administrators of all Union Territories (UTs) to exercise specified functions of the State Government under the National Dental Commission Act, 2023, within their respective jurisdictions. The Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) announced the decision through a notification issued under Article 239(1) of the Constitution.

articles.summary_hi: नई दिल्ली: राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मू ने सभी केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों (यूटी) के उपराज्यपालों और प्रशासकों को उनके संबंधित अधिकार क्षेत्र के भीतर राष्ट्रीय दंत चिकित्सा आयोग अधिनियम, 2023 के तहत राज्य सरकार के निर्दिष्ट कार्यों को करने की शक्तियां सौंप दी हैं। केंद्रीय गृह मंत्रालय (एमएचए) ने संविधान के अनुच्छेद 239(1) के तहत जारी एक अधिसूचना के माध्यम से निर्णय की घोषणा की।
articles.title_hinglish: rashtrapati murmu ne dentala kamishana adhiniyama ki shaktiyan yuti prashasakon ko saunpa din
articles.summary_hinglish: naee dilli: rashtrapati draupadi murmu ne sabhi kendra shasita pradeshon (yuti) ke uparajyapalon aura prashasakon ko unake sanbandhita adhikara kshetra ke bhitara rashtriya danta chikitsa aayoga adhiniyam, 2023 ke tahata rajya sarakara ke nirdishta karyon ko karane ki shaktiyan saunpa di hain। kendriya griha mantralaya (emaechae) ne sanvidhana ke anuchchheda 239(1) ke tahata jari eka adhisuchana ke madhyama se nirnaya ki ghoshana ki।

articles.title: Manoj Kumar Jha Examines the Rise of Political Cruelty in India
articles.summary: Analyst Manoj Kumar Jha examines the erosion of constitutional morality and the normalisation of political cruelty in India using Alan Wolfe's theory of political evil. The essay highlights majoritarianism, punitive demolitions, institutional weakening, and the suffering of vulnerable populations. These alarming trends threaten foundational democratic principles by placing political convenience above the rule of law.

articles.title: No engineering degree, 13 years of learning: Uttarakhand man builds flying car

articles.title: Zoho cofounder Sridhar Vembu says India must build using local talent
articles.summary: Zoho co-founder Sridhar Vembu stated on social media that India will only earn global respect by developing through its own domestic talent. Responding to mathematician Eric Weinstein regarding rising online hostility toward Indians, Vembu emphasized that focusing on national development is the ultimate response to criticism. He urged citizens to prioritize building the nation successfully.
articles.title_hi: ज़ोहो के सह-संस्थापक श्रीधर वेम्बू का कहना है कि भारत को स्थानीय प्रतिभा का उपयोग करके निर्माण करना चाहिए
articles.summary_hi: ज़ोहो के सह-संस्थापक श्रीधर वेम्बू ने सोशल मीडिया पर कहा कि भारत अपनी घरेलू प्रतिभा के माध्यम से विकास करके ही वैश्विक सम्मान अर्जित करेगा। भारतीयों के प्रति बढ़ती ऑनलाइन शत्रुता के बारे में गणितज्ञ एरिक वेन्स्टीन को जवाब देते हुए, वेम्बु ने इस बात पर जोर दिया कि राष्ट्रीय विकास पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना आलोचना की अंतिम प्रतिक्रिया है। उन्होंने नागरिकों से सफलतापूर्वक राष्ट्र निर्माण को प्राथमिकता देने का आग्रह किया।

articles.summary_hinglish: jaोho ke saha-sansthapaka shridhara vembu ne soshala midiya para kaha ki bharata apani gharelu pratibha ke madhyama se vikasa karake hi vaishvika sammana arjita karega। bharatiyon ke prati badhati ऑnalaina shatruta ke bare men ganitajnya erika venstina ko javaba dete hue, vembu ne isa bata para jora diya ki rashtriya vikasa para dhyana kendrita karana aalochana ki antima pratikriya hai। unhonne nagarikon se saphalatapurvaka rashtra nirmana ko prathamikata dene ka aagraha kiya।

articles.title: Congress demands answers from government on China border tensions and trade
articles.summary: On Friday, senior Congress leaders urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to clarify reports of border face-offs with China in Arunachal Pradesh. Leaders questioned whether military patrolling access has changed and expressed concern over a widening bilateral trade deficit. The opposition party demanded government accountability on national security and economic dependence regarding Beijing.
articles.title_hi: चीन सीमा तनाव और व्यापार पर कांग्रेस ने सरकार से मांगा जवाब
articles.summary_hi: शुक्रवार को वरिष्ठ कांग्रेस नेताओं ने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी से अरुणाचल प्रदेश में चीन के साथ सीमा पर झड़प की रिपोर्टों पर स्पष्टीकरण देने का आग्रह किया। नेताओं ने सवाल किया कि क्या सैन्य गश्त की पहुंच बदल गई है और बढ़ते द्विपक्षीय व्यापार घाटे पर चिंता व्यक्त की। विपक्षी दल ने बीजिंग को लेकर राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा और आर्थिक निर्भरता पर सरकार की जवाबदेही की मांग की.

articles.title: Citizen Justice Party Leaders Visit Delhi Police Station Over Jantar Mantar Protest
articles.summary: Citizen Justice Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, and Ajinkya Shinde arrived at Mandir Marg Police Station in Delhi for questioning. The Delhi Police Crime Branch summoned them regarding an October 13 protest at Jantar Mantar where members allegedly trespassed and obstructed officials after the site was de-notified. Ranka and Das recently were released from judicial custody.
articles.title_hi: जंतर मंतर विरोध को लेकर सिटीजन जस्टिस पार्टी के नेताओं ने दिल्ली पुलिस स्टेशन का दौरा किया

articles.title: India Steps Up Indigenous Telecom Research As C-DOT Establishes 6G, AI Centre At IIT
articles.summary: According to a Ministry of Communications release issued on Friday (23 October), C-DOT and IIT BHU signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to facilitate collaborative research, technology development and capacity building in emerging telecommunications technologies. The centre will focus on 5G Advanced and 6G technologies , artificial intelligence-driven communication systems, quantum and post-quantum communications, cybersecurity and advanced wireless networks.

articles.title: Uttarakhand replaces Friday holiday with Sunday for recognised madrasas
articles.summary: Madrasas, Islamic educational institutions, have traditionally observed Friday as their weekly holiday, allowing students and staff to attend congregational prayers. The new rule will apply to madrasas recognised by the state education department and those that have applied for recognition, The Print reported. Dhami said the change was intended to bring minority-run educational institutions under common academic and administrative standards.

articles.title: Punjab polls: Badal praises SAD-BJP rule as Amit Shah’s NDA pitch fuels reunion buzz
articles.summary: Speculation over a possible reunion between the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) gathered pace on Friday after SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal said his party was open to an alliance with parties that agree with its ideology and programmes, a day after Union home minister Amit Shah predicted an NDA government in Punjab in 2027.

articles.title: BREAKING: Swadeshi Jagran Manch Demands Ban on Starlink, Citing National Security Concerns
articles.summary: The RSS-affiliated Swadeshi Jagran Manch (SJM) has announced a protest in Delhi as it intensifies its campaign against Starlink’s proposed commercial rollout. SJM has urged the Centre to deny Starlink permission to operate, citing concerns over national security, data routing, lawful monitoring and the government’s ability to restrict internet connectivity during emergencies and law-and-order situations.

articles.summary_hinglish: aaraesaesa se judaे svadeshi jagarana mancha (esajeema) ne staralinka ke prastavita vanijyika rolaaauta ke khilapha apane abhiyana ko teja karate hue dilli men virodha pradarshana ki ghoshana ki hai। esajeema ne rashtriya suraksh, deta ruting, vaidha nigarani aura aapata sthiti aura kanuna-vyavastha sthitiyon ke daurana intaraneta kanektiviti ko pratibandhita karane ki sarakara ki kshamata para chintaon ka havala dete hue kendra se staralinka ko sanchalita karane ki anumati dene se inakara karane ka aagraha kiya hai।

articles.title: Bomb Threat email targets Chandigarh schools, Punjab Secretariat, Assembly and Mayor’s
articles.summary: Threatening email warns of explosions at multiple locations at specified times; security agencies conduct checks, with no bomb or suspicious object reported so far Security agencies have been put on high alert after several schools in Chandigarh, the Punjab Secretariat, the Punjab Assembly and the Mayor’s Office received a bomb threat via email on Friday morning.

articles.title: Upsurge Labs Launches Ninefold Pictures, Commits Over ₹250 Crore to Entertainment

articles.title: Kerala BJP leader surrenders year after Rs 8-cr heist in Qatar, claims he was
articles.summary: A Kerala man accused of helping steal 3. 1 million Qatari riyals (nearly Rs 8 crore) from a welfare fund in Doha has surrendered to police, nearly a year after the robbery. Parappil Balakrishnan, a Koyilandy resident, surrendered on Wednesday. He claims he was misled about the purpose of the job that took him to Qatar.

articles.summary_hinglish: doha men eka kalyana kosha se 3.1 miliyana katari riyala (lagabhaga 8 karoda rupaye) churane men madada karane ke aaropi kerala ke eka vyakti ne dakaiti ke lagabhaga eka sala bada pulisa ke samane aatmasamarpana kara diya hai। koyilaindi nivasi parappila balakrishnana ne budhavara ko aatmasamarpana kara diya। unaka dava hai ki unhen usa naukari ke uddeshya ke bare men gumaraha kiya gaya tha jo unhen katara le gaee thi।

articles.title: India smartphone market slumps 20% YoY, Samsung returns to No. 1 spot after nine
articles.summary: India's smartphone shipments fell 20% year-on-year (YoY) in the July-September quarter of 2026 to their lowest level in a decade, as rising memory prices pushed up phone costs and weakened demand. According to Counterpoint Research, Samsung reclaimed the top spot after nine quarters, with a 17% market share, as it performed better than the overall market.

articles.summary_hi: 2026 की जुलाई-सितंबर तिमाही में भारत की स्मार्टफोन शिपमेंट साल-दर-साल (YoY) 20% गिरकर एक दशक में सबसे निचले स्तर पर आ गई, क्योंकि मेमोरी की बढ़ती कीमतों ने फोन की लागत बढ़ा दी और मांग कमजोर हो गई। काउंटरप्वाइंट रिसर्च के अनुसार, सैमसंग ने 17% बाजार हिस्सेदारी के साथ नौ तिमाहियों के बाद शीर्ष स्थान हासिल किया, क्योंकि इसने समग्र बाजार से बेहतर प्रदर्शन किया।

articles.summary_hinglish: 2026 ki julaee-sitanbara timahi men bharata ki smartaphona shipamenta sala-dara-sala (YoY) 20% girakara eka dashaka men sabase nichale stara para aa gaee, kyonki memori ki badhati kimaton ne phona ki lagata badhaा di aura manga kamajora ho gaee। kauntarapvainta risarcha ke anusar, saimasanga ne 17% bajara hissedari ke satha nau timahiyon ke bada shirsha sthana hasila kiy, kyonki isane samagra bajara se behatara pradarshana kiya।

articles.title: Former Tamil Nadu BJP chief Annamalai criticises Modi government
articles.summary: Former Tamil Nadu Bharatiya Janata Party president K. Annamalai criticised the central government in Chennai on October 21 for its handling of protesters. Analysts believe this move helps him carve out an independent political identity and build grassroots strength after leaving the party earlier this year. His future remains uncertain as he navigates the local political landscape.

articles.title: Tripura Mourns 17 Lives Lost to Accidents, Crime in Durga Puja 2026
articles.summary: At least 17 people died across the state in the thirteen days between Mahalaya on October 10 and the post-Dashami holiday on October 22, in a string of incidents ranging from a double homicide in Dharmanagar and an alleged domestic murder in Boxanagar to fatal road crashes and a fairground ride malfunction on Vijaya Dashami morning.

articles.title: Who is Jintimani Kalita? Assam star makes India debut, gets cap from Harmanpreet Kaur
articles.summary: Jintimani Kalita took a big step in her cricketing journey on Friday as the young pacer made her India debut in the first women's ODI against Zimbabwe in Vadodara. The 22-year-old received her maiden India cap from Harmanpreet Kaur, marking a proud milestone for the Assam cricketer as she stepped onto the international stage.
articles.title_hi: कौन हैं जिन्तिमणि कलिता? असम स्टार ने भारत में पदार्पण किया, हरमनप्रीत कौर से कैप हासिल की
articles.summary_hi: जिन्तिमनी कलिता ने शुक्रवार को अपनी क्रिकेट यात्रा में एक बड़ा कदम उठाया जब युवा तेज गेंदबाज ने वडोदरा में जिम्बाब्वे के खिलाफ पहले महिला एकदिवसीय मैच में भारत के लिए पदार्पण किया। 22 वर्षीय खिलाड़ी ने हरमनप्रीत कौर से अपनी पहली भारतीय कैप प्राप्त की, जो असम के क्रिकेटर के लिए एक गौरवपूर्ण मील का पत्थर है क्योंकि उन्होंने अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंच पर कदम रखा था।
articles.title_hinglish: kauna hain jintimani kalit? asama stara ne bharata men padarpana kiy, haramanaprita kaura se kaipa hasila ki
articles.summary_hinglish: jintimani kalita ne shukravara ko apani kriketa yatra men eka badaा kadama uthaya jaba yuva teja gendabaja ne vadodara men jimbabve ke khilapha pahale mahila ekadivasiya maicha men bharata ke lie padarpana kiya। 22 varshiya khiladaी ne haramanaprita kaura se apani pahali bharatiya kaipa prapta ki, jo asama ke kriketara ke lie eka gauravapurna mila ka patthara hai kyonki unhonne antararashtriya mancha para kadama rakha tha।
